note: Missouri Department of Conservation area of wooded hills (including Brickey Hills Natural Area) between Highway 61 and the Mississippi River north of Ste. Genevieve, with an archery and shotgun range, hiking trails and a viewing platform. One primitive camping spot: a gravel pull-off under open trees beside the picnic area on the main gravel area road; no facilities. Reached from Route V by Magnolia Hollow Drive; MDC warns the area is difficult to reach when the Chester river gauge reaches 35 ft. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: one map/GIS-designated primitive camping spot (GIS 161) on a gravel pull-off beside the picnic area on the area road; pin sits on it. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Phone matches; not waterfront kept.
flags: INCLUSION OK: area page 'Things to Do When You Visit: Camping: Open Camping - Walk-in/Float-in/Backpack, Designated Camping Sites, Individual Campsites'; the 2025 area map shows one 'Primitive Camping' symbol beside the picnic area on the 'MDC Improved Road' east of the entrance lots; GIS 27 point 161 'Primitive Camping Area'. Rule 140 standard; no special-use-only rule, no Rule 101.
